title: Engine-level anti-tape gate re-run with shared market live
description: Re-run DESIGN.md §7 gate 2 (tape agent loses to mediocre reactive, win<30% over >=100 paired episodes) on the real engine with the shared market (contract bidding under volatile prices, penalty contracts) live — the symmetric-penalty, high-decision-density surface absent from prototypes. Also re-verify skill-dominance d_z>2.0 on the composite score at engine level. Acceptance: tape agents (allocation tape, PM-schedule tape, bid-price tape) all <30% win vs mediocre reactive; numbers in research/; verdict recorded in DESIGN.md §7. Design requirements in research/2026-10-13-acceptance-gates.md.

comments.author: dawn
comments.text: Picked up. Plan: TapeAgent variants replaying a recorded action stream (bids mapped by ordinal onto fresh contract draws, PM/probes/caps verbatim) vs mediocre reactive (shrewd) under fresh hyperprior draws, >=100 paired episodes per tape type on t3. Verdict target: tape win% < 30.

title: Phase0: anti-tape + skill-dominance acceptance gates
description: DESIGN.md §7 gates 2-3. Anti-tape: record action tape from strong-policy episode under seed S0; replay under perturbed hyperprior draws vs mediocre reactive agent; pass = tape win rate <30% over >=100 paired episodes. Skill dominance: scripted-good beats scripted-bad with d_z>2.0, p<0.01 at N<=200 episodes. Acceptance: both gates measured (fleet host), numbers recorded in research/, then freeze episode API v1 in DESIGN.md.

close_reason: Degradation sweep completed on t3 (2000 eps). CUSUM latency curve measured (B=4->8->16 cuts latency 32.2->25.6->22.2 ticks and missed breakdowns -47%). Findings recorded in research/2026-10-13-degradation-variance.md and DESIGN.md. Ready for amdrome-3zh.

comments.author: dawn
comments.text: Sweep complete (executed on fleet host t3 with python3.10, 2000 paired episodes across 400 seeds, <6s CPU). B=4->8->16 cuts CUSUM drift detection latency from 32.2 -> 25.6 -> 22.2 ticks and cuts missed breakdowns by -47%. Reactive SPC beats periodic PM by +70.9 net profit. Data saved to research/data/degradation/*.jsonl, analysis note in research/2026-10-13-degradation-variance.md, findings folded into DESIGN.md §6. Unblocks amdrome-3zh.

comments.author: dawn
comments.text: Design-loop step 2 done (layout mechanic, measured): built simulator/proto_layout.py (pure-stdlib, stateless CLI, ~0.6ms/episode) + research/layout_variance_analysis.py. Sweeps ran on dusk (2x 1200 paired episodes, <1s each). Findings (research/2026-10-13-layout-variance.md): layout explains 53-64% of cycle-time variance, scenario 24-32%, noise ~12-15% — skill-dominated anti-tape profile; distant-layout verdicts need 1-9 paired episodes (budget 200). Throughput only weakly layout-coupled -> score must weight cycle/WIP; lam hyperprior near saturation. AGV pool CUT from v1 (answered DESIGN §9 question). Runtime gate 4 comfortably met. Determinism rule added: never seed Random with str/tuple hash (PYTHONHASHSEED salting) — sha256->int via gen_seed(). DESIGN.md updated (§6 findings + §9). Next: mechanic-2 prototype (degradation/kanban SPC drift detection vs sample budget), then anti-tape acceptance test.
